items: `/verse-check`: asks the open UEFN to build the whole Verse project (through UEFN's own Verse Workflow Server, the channel Visual Studio Code uses) and reports clean, errors (with the build log) or not analyzed when UEFN is not reachable. Never a guess: an odd or missing answer is "not analyzed", not "clean".
The coder confirms the build with it before calling a task Done; the release gate runs it before a verdict (errors block, not analyzed caps the verdict at "ready with reservations").
New manual section "Checking that the code builds". Tests use a fake server for the three states.
release.title: v1.102.0 — Verse build check
